## Natural history notes

A large native mammal characterized by its stocky body, black fur, short tail, rounded ears, and strong limbs with large claws. In Florida, it is found mainly in forested habitats such as pine flatwoods, hardwood swamps, hammocks, and large natural areas with dense cover. It is an omnivore that feeds on fruits, nuts, insects, small animals, and carrion, and it requires large connected habitats for foraging, denning, and movement.
